 # *Strength blooms as shadows siphon*
 *Each strike echoes the Yōkai’s fang, mended by petals.*

 ---

The combination of  [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) +  [Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7) +  [Hidden Blade](item_a820416d-85e5-4018-b20a-dc1cbf744900) is absurdly strong. 
Use your quick melee **as much as possible**.

*WARNING : Do NOT buy [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) if you can't pair it with [Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7) and [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6), as you are mathematically losing value. Check the **💸 Item Guide** below for more details.*


## Quick math: why melee is actually busted

- Quick melee base damage : 40
-  [Hidden Blade](item_a820416d-85e5-4018-b20a-dc1cbf744900) : 15
-  [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) : +15%

The formula is *(Base Quick Melee * WP * Melee Damage) + Hidden Blade*

So this round, each Quick Melee deals :
- (40 * 1 * 1.15) + 15 = **61**

And you lifesteal 60% of Melee damage from [Hidden Blade](item_a820416d-85e5-4018-b20a-dc1cbf744900) + 25 from [Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7) + 5% of max health (over 2 seconds) from [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7).
Assuming you have 350 HP, each Quick Melee heals you :
- 61 * 0.6 + 25 + 350 * 0.05 = **79**

So basically every Quick Melee hits is a Kiriko kunai in damage and a Lifeweaver full blossom in healing.

# 💸 Detailed Item Guide

## 📉 If you have less than 9.5k

Keep your round 1 items, and buy in this priority : [Winning Attitude](item_8714087c-c078-4619-a2ef-327bc6edaa69), [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da), [Adrenaline Shot](item_ab8eba6a-0bda-4b12-8854-4ba4169b515f). 
Complete with [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) if you can.

## 📉 If you have less than 13k

[Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) + [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) + [Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7) + [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0).

*You can replace [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) with [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) if it helps you optimize your items more efficiently.*

This combo achieves similar stats as [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) while significantly boosting your shuriken damage. In this setup, you should try to play a bit less aggressively and focus more on poking. This actually aligns well with the situation : if you’re behind in economy, it usually means the enemy composition makes it harder to engage aggressively anyway. Complete with [Winning Attitude](item_8714087c-c078-4619-a2ef-327bc6edaa69) / [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) and/or [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) if you can.


## 📈 If you have more than 13k

Add green items with this priority : [Winning Attitude](item_8714087c-c078-4619-a2ef-327bc6edaa69), [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da), [Adrenaline Shot](item_ab8eba6a-0bda-4b12-8854-4ba4169b515f), [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0), [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf).

If you have more than 19.75k, fill the last slot with any blue item of your choice. If you are that rich, you’re probably good enough to figure out what to take by yourself.

# *The blade awakens*
*When defense falters, the phantom’s strike claims its due.*

---

## You are not the main character yet. 
**But you are a deadly self-reliant assassin.**

Keep the same disciplined playstyle, but now, thanks to the insane lifesteal from  [Iaido Strike](item_0b4def91-53c9-4bb7-b706-05aff6e4b168) with [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) , you can take riskier duels and pressure the tank.

You also want to use [Iaido Strike](item_0b4def91-53c9-4bb7-b706-05aff6e4b168) in chokepoints during early fights to benefit from the AoE damage and help take space.

If you have extra cash, make sure to prioritize green items.


---
# 💸 Detailed Item Guide

## 📉 If you have less than 23k : 

Prioritize [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) in most of cases. Complete your build with green survivability items as in the previous round, since being behind in cash likely means you are dying a lot and need extra sustain. Add [Custom Stock](item_17d633af-8bcc-4893-b865-be0a7bc66fe2) if you can.

The only scenario where you want to keep the [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) + [Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7) + [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6)  combo over [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643)  is when the enemy team is hard to [Iaido Strike](item_0b4def91-53c9-4bb7-b706-05aff6e4b168). In that case, get [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) + [Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7) + [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) , and complete with green items. Make sure that every item slot is filled.

Green items are in this order of priority : [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6)  [Winning Attitude](item_8714087c-c078-4619-a2ef-327bc6edaa69), [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da), [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0), [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf), [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418).

## 📈 If you have more than 23k :

Complete the build with the green items listed above. Take [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a), [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f), [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56)  or [Custom Stock](item_17d633af-8bcc-4893-b865-be0a7bc66fe2) instead of one of these if you can. Make sure that every item slot is filled.

If you are super rich (more than 33k), go for [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b). 

_No matter how much money you have, don’t forget to consider situational items like [Cushioned Padding](item_20f2f4bc-4611-4d1f-b653-20f04d56b96f) or [Anti-Beam Coating](item_1ab73e1c-aaa1-4026-89cd-68404db7fd93) if the enemy comp makes them valuable._

*Strength forged in patience readies the warrior’s final step.*

---

It's not much, but it's honest work.

# *The mask is lifted*
*The silent bane claims the spotlight.*

---

## It's time.

Now you're ready to destroy the lobby 1v5.

We say goodbye to our beloved [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) and [Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7), because now we want as much [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) as possible. Say hello to [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb) and [Three-tap Tommygun](item_39c5d2a4-1db0-444f-86d9-2a1e9a331429) .

Why ?

Because now you can perform the one-shot combo:
- 1) Get 5 [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b) stacks
- 2) Deflect into [Iaido Strike](item_0b4def91-53c9-4bb7-b706-05aff6e4b168)
- 3) Right-click + Swift Strike
- 4) Right-click + Quick Melee

For a faster combo, **use Swift Strike as soon as Dragonblade hits at step 3**. It reduces damage, but is 100% worth it to avoid getting interrupted.


### Your playstyle must shift : focus entirely on setting up your one-shot.

*Strike with fluid grace. Deflect, dash, dominate without pause.*

---

[Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448) is the best choice here.

# *You are the blade’s final truth*
*Unseen. Unstoppable. Unforgiving.*

---

Here’s what I consider the ultimate final build, with [Wyrm’s Maw](item_5d8c3488-13a9-432a-987e-275522f68cc4) to obliterate any target. Since you throw 5 shurikens after a [Iaido Strike](item_0b4def91-53c9-4bb7-b706-05aff6e4b168) , the [Wyrm’s Maw](item_5d8c3488-13a9-432a-987e-275522f68cc4) effect instantly maxes out, giving you a 50% damage boost for free on your Swift Strike.

For reference, a dash will then deal 
- (50 * (1.65 + 0.25)) * 1.5 = **142.5 damage**


I also included an alternative Dragonblade endgame build with [Dragon's Breath](item_32dc8374-7541-46fb-9891-29b7fbe9ed4d) for those who feel a little different. [Transference Delta](item_4bcdd047-90a2-43af-8d57-160cb21022ee) is okay, but [Champion's Kit](item_8682f8c7-8811-439b-8d50-fa81cd43ddce) is better if you have the money.

[Hanamura Healing](item_d210417d-1e30-4571-a4f3-cccd1dfc23ca) is also a very good option if you don't want to land shurikens before dashing, and/or need more sustain.

[Laceration](item_ee831ad3-3921-4aca-a761-c6b93cc7e7fe) is fine, but you get way more burst damage with  [Wyrm’s Maw](item_5d8c3488-13a9-432a-987e-275522f68cc4). Take it if the last map is very close and the enemy team is playing grouped.
